label: Contracts Finder
terms_note: Open Government Licence data; anonymous OCDS search; no rate limit published; publishing endpoints are for approved eOpportunity providers only.

discovery.auth: none for search (OAuth2 bearer token only for notice PUBLISHING by approved providers)

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes** for discovery (OCDS search + record/release + CSV exports) Confidence high (V1 + V2 API help pages opened).
auth: 2. Publishing (notice upload) only for approved eOpportunity providers: `POST` token endpoint → bearer `access_token` in the Authorization header (not needed by us).

endpoints.purpose: search — 'Search for published notice OCDS releases package with optional search criteria'
endpoints.notes: V2 params incl. AwardedToSME, AwardedToVCSE, ProcedureType…; pagination via `links.next`
current date or a specific date

reference.limits: - Open Government Licence; no rate limit published; standard HTTP error codes. - No proposal / message / contract endpoint exists — responses are lodged on the buyer's e-tendering system (assist card).

adapter.rate_note: No numeric limit published; the API pages say HTTP 403 means 'The request rate limit may have been exceeded' and to wait five minutes before retrying. Published (read) endpoints are anonymous; OAuth2 tokens are only for notice publishing.

search_postings.note: OCDS release package: documented parameters are publishedFrom, publishedTo (ISO 8601), stages (planning, tender, award, implementation), limit (1-100, default 100) and cursor. `stages=tender` is fixed so only tender-stage notices are listed; there is no keyword parameter, so `query`, `category` and `min_budget` are not sent (filter client-side). Paging is by cursor (`links.next`), which page/limit cannot carry: `page` is ignored and only the first `limit` releases are returned. `id` is the OCDS release `id` (notice GUID plus a version suffix) accepted by get_posting; the process `ocid` stays in raw (live check 2026-09-26: the documented Published/OCDS/Record/{ocid} answers 404 for every ocid, including the documentation's own sample); value/deadline/buyer come from the OCDS tender block documented on the Record page.

get_posting.note: GET Published/OCDS/Release/{id} ('Get the OCDS release package by the provided id'): `id` is the release id returned by search_postings (e.g. e2d9dc88-6503-4899-a4b0-76f0a5c96ffe-915593); releases[0] (tender{title, description, value, tenderPeriod}, buyer{name}, date) is mapped and the ocid stays in raw. Record/{ocid} is not used: on 2026-09-26 it answered 404 NotFound for every ocid, including the documentation's own sample. 404 when the release id is unknown.

not_offered.submit_bid: Page: 'No proposal / message / contract endpoint exists — responses are lodged on the buyer's e-tendering system'; the only writes (draft/publish notices) are for approved eOpportunity providers.
not_offered.list_messages: No messaging API; the page documents the public listing feed only.
not_offered.send_message: No messaging API; the page documents the public listing feed only.
not_offered.credits: No account or credit endpoint; the feed is keyless.
not_offered.me: No credentials to verify ('auth: none') and no account endpoint.
